invariants.rationale: If b is nonzero, division proceeds and result is the integer division; if b is zero, an alternate value is returned.
If b equals zero, result is set to Integer.MIN_VALUE as a sentinel.

invariants.expression: b != 0 ==> result * b <= a && result * b > a - Math.abs(b)
invariants.rationale: For integer division, the result times divisor is in the range [a - |b| + 1, a] (division truncates toward zero).
Dividing by one yields the dividend itself as the result.
Dividing by negative one negates a unless a is Integer.MIN_VALUE, which cannot be negated safely in Java.
